title: UL-18 — Challenge: ECS on Fargate
scenario: Run Fargate task, bump CPU/memory one tier, run again, tear down.
acceptanceCriteria: Name the resources you create `workbook-ul18`: cluster `workbook-ul18`, task definition family `workbook-ul18`, execution role `workbook-ul18-task`, log group `/ecs/workbook-ul18` and security group `workbook-ul18-sg` if you create them. Tag each one LabId=ul-18.
CPU and memory changed once to next Fargate size tier for pricing comparison.
Second task run uses updated task definition revision.
Public IP only if needed and released after stop.
CloudWatch log group deleted if created.
stopChargesPanel: Scale services to 0 and delete them, stop running tasks, deregister task definitions, delete the cluster, log group, security group and IAM role for ul-18.

orderedDeletesPowerShell: # Lost an ID? aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-18
# Services first (a service restarts its tasks), then any task still running

foreach ($Svc in ((aws ecs list-services --cluster workbook-ul18 --query serviceArns --output text) -split '\s+')) { if ($Svc -and $Svc -ne 'None') { aws ecs update-service --cluster workbook-ul18 --service $Svc --desired-count 0 --query service.desiredCount --output text; aws ecs delete-service --cluster workbook-ul18 --service $Svc --force --query service.status --output text; aws ecs wait services-inactive --cluster workbook-ul18 --services $Svc } }

foreach ($TaskArn in ((aws ecs list-tasks --cluster workbook-ul18 --desired-status RUNNING --query taskArns --output text) -split '\s+')) { if ($TaskArn -and $TaskArn -ne 'None') { aws ecs stop-task --cluster workbook-ul18 --task $TaskArn --reason ul-18-teardown --query task.lastStatus --output text; aws ecs wait tasks-stopped --cluster workbook-ul18 --tasks $TaskArn } }

foreach ($TdArn in ((aws ecs list-task-definitions --family-prefix workbook-ul18 --status ACTIVE --query taskDefinitionArns --output text) -split '\s+')) { if ($TdArn -and $TdArn -ne 'None') { aws ecs deregister-task-definition --task-definition $TdArn --query taskDefinition.status --output text } }

foreach ($P in (aws iam list-attached-role-policies --role-name workbook-ul18-task --query "AttachedPolicies[].[PolicyArn]" --output text)) { if ($P) { aws iam detach-role-policy --role-name workbook-ul18-task --policy-arn $P } }

foreach ($P in ((aws iam list-role-policies --role-name workbook-ul18-task --query PolicyNames --output text) -split '\s+')) { if ($P -and $P -ne 'None') { aws iam delete-role-policy --role-name workbook-ul18-task --policy-name $P } }
verification: aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-18 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
aws ecs list-task-definitions --family-prefix workbook-ul18 --status ACTIVE returns an empty taskDefinitionArns list
aws iam get-role --role-name workbook-ul18-task returns NoSuchEntity
teardown.stillBillingNote: Time already used, transfer, tax, and 8–12h billing lag may still appear. Alerts do not delete resources.
teardown.recovery: If teardown fails, stop. Confirm $env:AWS_REGION is us-east-1 and the caller is not root. Run aws sts get-caller-identity and type that Account value before any delete. List LabId=ul-18 with aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-18. Delete only those ids. Never delete untagged resources. If delete-cluster returns ClusterContainsServicesException or ClusterContainsTasksException, rerun the service and task lines and wait until they finish. If the security group delete returns DependencyViolation, wait a minute for the task ENI to be released and rerun it.

beforeYouStart: Read the paired guided lab (gl-18) stop-charges panel before you create anything.
Set $env:AWS_PROFILE and $env:AWS_REGION. Do not use the root user.
